description:
About Signify 

 Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.

 At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.

 Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world. 

 More about the role 

 This is an exciting job opportunity for you to light the way as a Data Engineer in Kętrzyn (Poland) with Signify. You will interact with various departments from the factory, R&D, product management, and more around Europe, learn new skills, and grow your career. Your work will make a huge and high-tech impact not only for the organization but more importantly, for the end users of our products!
  
 In this role, you will be responsible for the product and technical data management within SAP. Strong data management skills are essential and should come naturally to you!

 What you'll do 
 Manage and maintain product data and costing information in SAP, including creating smart products configurators and unique material codes for finished goods and components
 Ensure high-quality, error-free product data entry and secure product data upload to different cloud systems
 Support end-of-life processes by cleaning and phasing out obsolete product and component data
 Participate in and lead at least one data management improvement project per year
 Calculate and update standard prices for new and existing products, including quarterly price updates
 Support business with deal and pricing analysis, providing data-driven insights and suggestions for cost improvement
 Collaborate with product management and product engineers in New Product Introduction projects
 Contribute to the central data engineering community and participate in cross-factory projects
  
 More about you 
 While we value and appreciate all applicants, we believe that the following experience and skills will be needed to shine brightly in this job opening:
 The ideal educational background combines finance, economics, and IT/programming
 Appropriate skills of data management (SAP, Excel, etc..)is a requirement for this role
 Understanding of data conceptualization and IT applications
 Ability to work with and analyze data, including product data management and costing
 Analytical mindset with a focus on continuous improvement
 Confidence and eagerness to learn quickly
 Proficiency in both English and Polish is required for this role
 
 Everything we’ll do for you 

 You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together. 

 Come join us, and together we can light up the future.
